nodes.label: Label-Left Control-Right Row
nodes.rationale: Each setting is a two-column row: a left-aligned name and a right-aligned control of uniform width so mixed widget types (checkbox, slider, text, combo, color, keybind) share one visual grid.

nodes.label: Integer Versus Number Slider Split
nodes.rationale: Integer and Number share the same slider chrome but differ in readout: Integer shows a whole value (2) while Number shows a decimal (0.1), so discrete and continuous numeric settings are distinct widget types.

nodes.label: RGBA Hex Extends RGB Color
nodes.rationale: Color without alpha uses a 6-digit RGB hex (00FFFF) beside a saturated swatch; Color with alpha uses an 8-digit RGBA hex (00000055) beside a semi-transparent swatch, so alpha is an extra nibble pair on the same color-row pattern.

nodes.label: Plugin Config Widget Catalog
nodes.rationale: The dialog is a demo catalog of supported plugin config widgets, not a live product page: dummy labels (Toggle, Integer, Number, Text, Dropdown, Color, Color with alpha, Keybind, Button) and placeholder values (Default Text, First Alpha, none) enumerate every control type the config UI can host.

nodes.label: Anomaly Shader Framework
nodes.rationale: Anomaly is optional: discovered at runtime by type name with no compile-time reference.

nodes.label: Reactive Mask
nodes.rationale: Catalog reactiveMask is bound as DLSS bias-current-color when a pack marks pixels that must not use history.

nodes.label: VelocityRegistry
nodes.rationale: Motion vectors are camera-reprojected from depth unless Anomaly VelocityRegistry.Active provides object motion.

nodes.label: AnomalyAcceptance Harness
nodes.rationale: dotnet run --project Tests/AnomalyAcceptance.csproj. Does not exercise D3D, NGX, or certify rendered image quality.

nodes.label: NGX Motion Vector Flags
nodes.rationale: NGX scale is (+1,+1), MVLowRes enabled, MVJittered disabled. Legacy 7 and unknown flags fall back.

nodes.label: Velocity Convention 15
nodes.rationale: Unjittered, internal pixel units, Y down, current-to-previous. previousPixel = currentPixel + motion.

nodes.label: Anomaly Owns Shared Gaps
nodes.rationale: When this pack invents lighting, IsolatedMix energy, or march LOD that the next Anomaly shader will also need, file it on Anomaly Docs/Extensibility.md Slice AI and wiki/Framework-gaps.md.

nodes.label: Anti-aliasing Setting
nodes.rationale: Only one upscaler can be selected. Shared with Options Graphics and FRS.

nodes.label: AntiAliasingHandshake
nodes.rationale: Well-known type ClientPlugin.Dlss.AntiAliasingHandshake / ClientPlugin.Frs.AntiAliasingHandshake with no compile-time reference. Graphics combo keys 100 DLSS and 101 FRS.

nodes.label: DLSS Frame Generation
nodes.rationale: Frame Generation is not supported.

nodes.label: MSAA
nodes.rationale: MSAA is not in the current graphics UI and is incompatible with DLSS.

nodes.label: Rich HUD Config Save Rule
nodes.rationale: Rich HUD sliders must not serialize or write config on every tick.

nodes.label: Commercial Release Notification
nodes.rationale: Must notify NVIDIA prior to commercial release of an application or plug-in that incorporates DLSS SDK, NGX SDK or RTX Dynamic Vibrance SDK.

nodes.label: SDK Distribution Requirements
nodes.rationale: Application must have material additional functionality beyond included SDK portions; distribute SDK material only as object code incorporated into an application.

nodes.label: NVIDIA GPU Interoperability Requirement
nodes.rationale: DLSS SDK, NGX SDK and RTX Dynamic Vibrance SDK are licensed only for systems with NVIDIA GPUs.

nodes.label: HasDisplayTenant
nodes.rationale: When HasDisplayTenant or swapchain is already scRGB, DLSS skips Keen SDR and evaluates catalog hdrColor into fp16 dest with NGX IsHDR.

nodes.label: NVIDIA NGX
nodes.rationale: Does not use NVIDIA public NGX SDK shim. Loads driver private _nvngx.dll and calls private exports.

nodes.label: DispCallFunc Trampoline
nodes.rationale: OleAut32 DispCallFunc trampoline so the driver sees a native return address.

nodes.label: NGX Fail Closed
nodes.rationale: Fails closed on NGX error codes and defaults to off. A native access violation during init cannot be caught from .NET Framework.

nodes.label: Probe Metadata Fail Closed
nodes.rationale: Missing probe metadata fails closed. Catalog cannot certify conventions and is no longer a velocity fallback. Keep probes Off for captures.

nodes.label: SmoothFrames
nodes.rationale: Interpolated camera vs jittered projection fights temporal history. Disable SmoothFrames camera interpolation while DLSS is on.
